title: Glean: Application Security Engineer
content:
Glean: Application Security Engineer

Headquarters: United States, Remote About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for an experienced Application Security Engineer with a primary focus on ensuring that our entire technology stack is free of software vulnerabilities (CVEs). This role is responsible for securing our base OS images, ensuring all open-source software (OSS) dependencies are scanned and patched, and integrating cutting-edge security tools into our CI/CD pipeline. The ideal candidate will drive the adoption of solutions like Google’s Assured Open Source Software (OSS) and explore alternative approaches to enhance software security. This role will lead the vulnerability management charter at Glean, identifying, evaluating, and implementing new security technologies and processes to proactively protect our infrastructure. You will: Own the vulnerability management lifecycle across Glean’s technology stack, from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and measurement. Harden base OS images and secure open-source dependencies, package managers, and the broader software supply chain. Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and automated security validation into CI/CD pipelines. Evaluate, adopt, and develop security solutions and tooling, including Google’s Assured OSS and comparable approaches. Define secure-coding practices and drive engineering adoption through guidance, training, and mentorship. About you: BA/BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience). 8+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability management. Deep understanding of software security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, OWASP Top 10, and supply chain risks. Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management tools (e.g., Snyk, GitHub Dependabot, Trivy, Clair, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP). Hands-on experience with cloud-native security across AWS, GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, and microservices. Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive security adoption across engineering teams. Proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance security with performance and usability. Location: This role is remote Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $185,000 - $260,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-REMOTE AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. title: Adventure Travel 365: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
content:
Adventure Travel 365: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life. We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more. This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us. What You’ll Help Us Build The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. Some of the functionality we’re planning includes: Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management Job and project tracking Client and vendor dashboards Online payments and transaction tracking Reviews and ratings Notifications and communications Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities Admin tools for managing the platform Reporting and analytics Secure management of user, job, and transaction data And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it. This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. Who We’re Looking For We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform. You should be comfortable with: Full-stack web development Mobile or cross-platform app development Strong front-end and back-end development Multi-user marketplace platforms User authentication and account management Payment gateway integrations Databases and APIs Third-party integrations Dashboards and reporting Secure, scalable application architecture Cloud hosting and deployment Testing, maintenance, and optimization Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it. More Than Just Coding We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding. We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow. You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform. You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way. Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team. This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time. Interested? Tell Us About Yourself Please send us: A quick introduction Your resume or LinkedIn profile Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on What you personally worked on for those projects Your experience using AI in development What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why Your availability A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate. Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it. title: Toggl: Senior Full Stack
content:
Toggl: Senior Full Stack

Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale. We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long. This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor. You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one. You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models. You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day. You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition. In this role, you will: Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details. Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI. Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems. Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes. Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators. Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale. Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products. Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar). Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact. Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love. Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved. An ideal candidate also has: Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI. Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain. A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
